title: Vendor Lateness Settlement of Damage Allowances on Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
The damage allowance on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent is settled against the vendor's lateness once it has been rounded to the cent.

**Clause.** The lateness is the number of calendar days by which the ready date is later than the promised ready date. The allowance figure rounded to the nearest cent is settled as follows: beyond twice the program's vendor delay threshold, the figure is raised by one half of itself and rounded to the nearest cent; beyond the threshold but not beyond twice it, 75.00 is added to the figure; otherwise the figure stands. The settled figure is the allowance booked.

## Bands for the deposit programs

| Program | Threshold (days) | Raised by one half | 75.00 added | Figure stands |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 21 | more than 42 days late | 22 to 42 days late | 21 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 21 | more than 42 days late | 22 to 42 days late | 21 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 14 | more than 28 days late | 15 to 28 days late | 14 days late or less |

## Worked figures (hypothetical Semi-Custom Cabinetry order, rounded figure 270.00)

| Days late | Allowance booked |
|---|---|
| 0 | 270.00 |
| 21 | 270.00 |
| 22 | 345.00 |
| 42 | 345.00 |
| 43 | 405.00 |

The half added is half of the figure already rounded to the cent.
